name: United Piping Solutions
introduction: United Piping Solutions is an international industrial piping materials supply and distribution organization based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. From the DMCC free zone, we connect international producers with customers across energy, chemical, petrochemical, shipbuilding, mechanical engineering, and infrastructure markets.
mission: Deliver dependable, cost-effective industrial piping solutions through technical knowledge, quality-focused sourcing, coordinated services, and close attention to customer requirements.
vision: Become a trusted international piping solutions partner recognized for technical competence, quality, reliability, and continued improvement.
